Type: open shelf console table
Use: display and storage behind a sofa or in an entry; living room, hallway, dining room
Style: farmhouse, rustic, coastal
Materials: solid pine, slatted shelves, light oak finish
Colors: light warm oak, honey
Shape: double cube frame, X-braced sides and center, two slatted lower shelves, solid top, boxy and medium weight
Feel: warm, casual, homey
Goes with: white walls, woven baskets, linen, greenery; farmhouse or coastal rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Solid Pine Rustic Farmhouse Console Table, 52"W, Rustic Oak
product.description: This console table’s light finish and simple design mean it will be home with any decor—traditional or modern. X-shaped detailing on the sides provides dimension in any space. Sturdy pine construction and two wide shelves make this table a great storage option as well as a stylish focal point. 52"W x 15"D x 30"H Solid pine construction The simple design features two split shelves to store your small items. Solid wood construction creates a sturdy base to help keep items secure. Use this piece as the perfect finishing touch for your farmhouse decor or as a way to add a rustic touch to your existing design scheme. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Avoid moisture. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
